title: Kitten wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <!-- body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#ffd48a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='24' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='30,32 26,10 45,24' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <polygon points='33,30 31,17 43,26' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <polygon points='70,32 74,10 55,24' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <polygon points='67,30 69,17 57,26' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <polygon points='46,24 50,32 54,24 52,22 50,26 48,22' fill='#d97e12'/>
  <!-- sunglasses frames -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='21' height='14' rx='6' fill='#5b2d8e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='38' width='21' height='14' rx='6' fill='#5b2d8e'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='46' y='42' width='8' height='4' fill='#5b2d8e'/>
  <!-- lenses -->
  <rect x='29' y='41' width='15' height='8' rx='4' fill='#2b1b4d'/>
  <rect x='56' y='41' width='15' height='8' rx='4' fill='#2b1b4d'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='31' y='42' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8f7fd0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='42' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8f7fd0'/>
  <!-- arms of glasses -->
  <rect x='20' y='41' width='7' height='3' fill='#5b2d8e'/>
  <rect x='73' y='41' width='7' height='3' fill='#5b2d8e'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='48,56 52,56 50,59' fill='#ff7fae'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 59 q-3 5 -6 2' stroke='#c96a08' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 59 q3 5 6 2' stroke='#c96a08' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='55' x2='15' y2='52' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='59' x2='14' y2='61' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='55' x2='85' y2='52' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='59' x2='86' y2='61' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='93' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffd48a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='93' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffd48a'/>
</svg>
